alongcornflake: Henrik Alongcornfla arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in P-F5 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik Alongcornfla during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Someone in P-F5 asked Henrik Alongcornfla about Ashford Vale. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Alongcornfla. Henrik Alongcornfla read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Alongcornfla reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F5 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Roland Kahuna of the Concord (@kahuna382000). Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Alongcornfla. Henrik Alongcornfla read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Alongcornfla crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at P-F5 holds again. Henrik Alongcornfla no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Henrik Alongcornfla waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Alongcornfla. Henrik Alongcornfla read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Henrik Alongcornfla was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
The medic looked at Henrik Alongcornfla's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to P-F5. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
A muddy dog crawled into P-F5 through the wire. Henrik gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Shrapnel.
beanyboio40: The draft reached W-F17 on Day 17. Walter "Ash" Beanyboio was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Walter added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
berufsnerd: Zeno Berufsnerd arrived on Day 11 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Grey Mill is lost. Zeno Berufsnerd heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Zeno Berufsnerd tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Zeno Berufsnerd caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
Zeno Berufsnerd ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Lightning lit Hill 304 and Zeno Berufsnerd saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.
Dawn watch. Zeno Berufsnerd put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Felix "Tin" Walker, grazed.
Zeno Berufsnerd kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
At N-F13 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Zeno won the bet. Leopold Banter was grazed.
brandon_marc_beck: In Dunmarrow, Ivo "Rabbit" Beck was a lamplighter. In R-F5, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Ivo "Rabbit" Beck could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Dawn watch. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Karel "Ash" World, badly wounded.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Norbert Sharky was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Norbert Sharky was badly wounded. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck ate breakfast without a word. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck swept the enemy parapet at R-F5 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Matthias World was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Pavel "Bones" Jarg. The Concord medics will be busy. (@j14ar08g06) Ivo "Rabbit" Beck went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Gustav "Spark" Echoss did not get up again. (@echoss_3) Ivo "Rabbit" Beck walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Two men fed the belt while Ivo "Rabbit" Beck held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Dietrich Mindblot was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 231. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Pavel Rvmn was grazed trying to cross it. A bullet went through Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's upper arm at R-F5 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix of the Concord (@dratlaix). Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Zeno "Button" Joha was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck aimed a step ahead and fired: Isidor "Mole" Raptor, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys was down and screaming for a medic. (@geronimoleysen) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. A letter reached Ivo "Rabbit" Beck with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck tried to as well.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck guessed what they were and laughed.
Ivo is well again. He hung his bandages on a nail at R-F5 like medals. Ivo got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
captain_lonerius: The quartermaster asked Valentin "Bones" Lonerius to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R15 with the rations. Valentin "Bones" Lonerius ate while listening to the revised orders.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Valentin "Bones" Lonerius aimed a step ahead and fired: Zeno Ramsey, grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Valentin "Bones" Lonerius answered to number 954. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin "Bones" Lonerius looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Valentin "Bones" Lonerius fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Teodor Donaldgregor, now grazed.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Teodor Donaldgregor, badly wounded. Valentin "Bones" Lonerius cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Valentin "Bones" Lonerius wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Valentin "Bones" Lonerius found an old map of Hill 304 from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Valentin "Bones" Lonerius and Hugo Knoturbro divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

A bullet hit Valentin "Bones" Lonerius in the neck at S-R15. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Marek Kowalien of the Hegemony (@kowalien). Valentin "Bones" Lonerius was killed outright at S-R15, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Marek Kowalien of the Hegemony (@kowalien).
Walter Lonerius came to the front because his uncle Valentin "Bones" Lonerius never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
In reserve, Walter washed a shirt in a bucket and hung it on a rifle to dry. It looked like a flag of surrender.
colepatriquin: Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui arrived on Day 14 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A recruit asked Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui. Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. At V-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui turned around and took a shovel blow. Valentin Nothing of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Valentin Nothing of the Concord (@nothing_va1). A letter from home reached Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui before dusk. Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui read it twice and slept a little easier.

The wound on Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui. Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet grazed Gideon's ribs at V-F6. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Casimir Lilly of the Concord (@_bell_lilly_). There was a parcel for Gideon: socks, a cake, and a note that said eat the cake first. Gideon ate the cake first.
duckman38259: In Saint-Lune, Yann Duckman was a ferryman. In S-R10, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a ferryman again.

Blackwater Canal has been won. Yann Duckman listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. Yann Duckman's transfer to the role of field cook was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A round went through Yann Duckman's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Ulrich Axelat of the Concord (@axelat3). Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Duckman. Yann Duckman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Yann Duckman helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Yann Duckman is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Duckman. Yann Duckman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Duckman and Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Duckman. Yann Duckman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Yann Duckman went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.

Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Yann Duckman accepted it as a review. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Duckman. Yann Duckman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Duckman went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Edmund Callmequeeno did not get up again. (@callmequeenorea_) Yann Duckman went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@vuminhtri260709)

Yann Duckman made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Duckman. Yann Duckman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix Jesus and Yann Duckman made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Yann read the letter from his father twice. It was short. It said: we are proud of you, and the dog misses you.
emile_in_paris: "You're late," said the corporal when Teodor "Smokes" Paris arrived on Day 13. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

A bullet went through Teodor "Smokes" Paris's upper arm at N-F22 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Konrad "Button" Jasierralta of the Hegemony (@jasierralta). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Teodor "Smokes" Paris fell at N-F22 and never moved again. Shot by Konrad "Button" Jasierralta of the Hegemony (@jasierralta).
The papers connected Florian "Brick" Paris to Teodor "Smokes" Paris. The men took longer to learn Florian "Brick" Paris's own habits, but they made the effort.
A clear shot from N-F22. Florian "Brick" Paris badly wounded Hugo Baroosal and slid back down below the parapet.
Across from N-F22, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Florian "Brick" Paris saw it. Severin "Saint" Neurotoxic was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at N-F22, Florian "Brick" Paris fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Valentin Jasierralta, now gravely wounded.

Florian did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Florian fired back. Anselm "Shadow" Theorethical was grazed. The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Florian fired, and Viktor Benb was badly wounded.
gaita_4119: Rafael "Bones" Gaita took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Stand-to at dawn. Rafael "Bones" Gaita put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Nils Photo, badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Rafael "Bones" Gaita looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell burst in the trench at S-F8. Rafael "Bones" Gaita was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.

Rafael "Bones" Gaita lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Rafael "Bones" Gaita. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F8 today. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 has been won. Rafael "Bones" Gaita listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rafael "Bones" Gaita bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Rafael "Bones" Gaita put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

Rafael "Bones" Gaita wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Rafael "Bones" Gaita used it. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was badly wounded. Rafael "Bones" Gaita raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo). A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics cleaned Rafael "Bones" Gaita's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.
Rafael "Bones" Gaita was on watch at S-F8 when the night raid hit. The men found Rafael "Bones" Gaita at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Florian Hsrr of the Concord (@jere.hsrr).
The papers say Matthias "Doc" Gaita. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Rafael "Bones" Gaita's eyes. Nobody in S-F8 argues.

Asked what he will do after the war, Matthias "Doc" Gaita said: 'Be a baker in Esterhaus. And never complain about anything, ever again.' Matthias "Doc" Gaita got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 131. The men who came later will ask about it. Matthias "Doc" Gaita walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Matthias "Doc" Gaita was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval was grazed.
Dietrich Wolfmananton pulled Matthias "Doc" Gaita out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Matthias "Doc" Gaita checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

Across from S-F8, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Matthias "Doc" Gaita saw it. Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato was grazed. Matthias "Doc" Gaita was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F8. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc). A single shot at S-F8. Matthias "Doc" Gaita sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc).
Jonas Gaita asked about Matthias "Doc" Gaita on arriving at S-F8. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F8 and grazed Jonas Gaita's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Henrik Rossfm of the Concord (@rossfm82).
Jonas Gaita came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Jonas fired, and Gideon "Shadow" Willskeltony was grazed. Jonas was hit in the hip at S-F8. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Oskar Zczc of the Concord (@zczc1317). A single bullet found Jonas at S-F8. He dropped without a word, and the rifle slid down beside him.
Bram Gaita arrived carrying the family name of Jonas Gaita. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
general_andi18: By the time Rafael Andi reached T-F19, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Rafael Andi washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. A letter from home reached Rafael Andi before dusk. Rafael Andi read it twice and slept a little easier. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Rafael Andi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A flare lit the Sunken Road like noon. Rafael Andi counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Rafael Andi spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.

Rafael Andi carried Ivo "Saint" Klaymore's rifle all the way up to Blackwater Canal after Saint twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. A letter from home reached Rafael Andi before dusk. Rafael Andi read it twice and slept a little easier.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F19 and grazed Rafael Andi's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Dietrich Rmr of the Concord (@rmr7015).
Fever took hold of Rafael Andi overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.

The medics called Rafael Andi 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Rafael Andi is back on the line. Rafael Andi read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
The cook's fire went out. Rafael relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
hammerthysteel: Nobody asked Zeno Hammerthyste why he came. Nobody in R-R1 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Zeno Hammerthyste during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A recruit asked Zeno Hammerthyste how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Zeno Hammerthyste helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Zeno Hammerthyste made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Zeno Hammerthyste of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Verdel Ridge. Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Zeno Hammerthyste was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-R1. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon.
Zeno Hammerthyste waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Zeno Hammerthyste no longer needed it.
The papers say Konrad Hammerthyste. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Zeno Hammerthyste's eyes. Nobody in R-R1 argues.
Konrad Hammerthyste found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-R1. Konrad Hammerthyste fired at the last man to run. Emil Birdy was grazed.
Konrad keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a key to a house that is no longer there. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
hawkenram: The new machine gunner gave his name as Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet went through Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Viktor Newnario of the Hegemony (@newnario).
Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A bullet clipped Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's helmet at R-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).

A single shot from across the wire hit Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram in the thigh at R-F16. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram fell at R-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
The House of Hawkenram sent another. Oskar Hawkenram, brother of Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
An empty jam tin became Oskar Hawkenram's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Oskar Hawkenram came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. A letter from home reached Oskar Hawkenram before dusk. Oskar Hawkenram read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Hawkenram was on watch at R-F16 when the night raid hit. The men found Oskar Hawkenram at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum).
Pavel Hawkenram had heard about Oskar Hawkenram's courage. At R-F16, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Pavel Hawkenram saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Hawkenram answered to number 122. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Pavel Hawkenram read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Pavel Hawkenram approved the method. A letter from home reached Pavel Hawkenram before dusk. Pavel Hawkenram read it twice and slept a little easier. Pavel Hawkenram bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Pavel Hawkenram was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' Pavel Hawkenram found a muddy border collie shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Pavel Hawkenram calls it Wolf.

Pavel Hawkenram dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home reached Pavel Hawkenram before dusk. Pavel Hawkenram read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F16 and grazed Pavel Hawkenram's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. A letter from home reached Pavel Hawkenram before dusk. Pavel Hawkenram read it twice and slept a little easier.
Pavel Hawkenram is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F16. Pavel Hawkenram was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Summer of the Hegemony (@summer.l_21).

Severin "Crow" Hawkenram joined R-F16 under the shadow of Pavel Hawkenram's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Wolf the border collie was waiting at the end of the trench. It sniffed Severin "Crow" Hawkenram for a long time, then lay down at his feet. It stays with the family.

Someone in R-F16 asked Severin "Crow" Hawkenram about Lindenbruck. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter reached Severin "Crow" Hawkenram in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

On dawn watch at R-F16, Severin fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Jakub "Shadow" Barrett, now grazed. The mail sergeant held up an envelope and shouted a name. It was Severin. The whole trench clapped.
jasierralta: Konrad "Button" Jasierralta came up on Day 11 carrying news from Dunmarrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Konrad "Button" Jasierralta counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Severin Geraldkisner was grazed.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Konrad "Button" Jasierralta fired, and Jonas Phosphor was gravely wounded.
On dawn watch at P-F2, Konrad "Button" Jasierralta fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Teodor "Smokes" Paris, now badly wounded.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Konrad "Button" Jasierralta across the shin at P-F2. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Oskar Xxirosasxx of the Concord (@xxirosasxx).

Konrad "Button" Jasierralta was hit in the hip at P-F2. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Gideon Phosphor of the Concord (@white__phosphor). Konrad "Button" Jasierralta asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Valentin Jasierralta had heard about Konrad "Button" Jasierralta's courage. At P-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet went into Valentin Jasierralta's chest just under the heart at P-F2. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Florian "Brick" Paris of the Concord (@emile_in_paris). Nobody could reach Valentin Jasierralta in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
The papers say Matthias Jasierralta. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Valentin Jasierralta's eyes. Nobody in P-F2 argues.

A bullet hit Matthias in the neck at P-F2. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Benedikt Daremiamor of the Concord (@daremiamor). The bearers reached Matthias at P-F2 too late. One shot, and it was over.
The House of Jasierralta sent another. Gustav Jasierralta, uncle of Matthias Jasierralta, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
jessemusoff: Pavel Jessemusoff came from Lindenbruck, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. Pavel Jessemusoff left the work of a rifleman to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel Jessemusoff wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Pavel Jessemusoff before dusk. Pavel Jessemusoff read it twice and slept a little easier.

Pavel Jessemusoff pulled Otto Mihai out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home reached Pavel Jessemusoff before dusk. Pavel Jessemusoff read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Jessemusoff is number 993 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Jessemusoff watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Behind the lines Pavel Jessemusoff had a bath in a beer vat with eleven other men. The water was brown before he got in. A letter from home reached Pavel Jessemusoff before dusk. Pavel Jessemusoff read it twice and slept a little easier.

Pavel Jessemusoff started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." A letter from home reached Pavel Jessemusoff before dusk. Pavel Jessemusoff read it twice and slept a little easier.

Pavel Jessemusoff's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." A letter from home reached Pavel Jessemusoff before dusk. Pavel Jessemusoff read it twice and slept a little easier.

Pavel Jessemusoff was hit through the stomach at S-R17. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Dick of the Hegemony (@dick_j0b). Pavel Jessemusoff was killed outright at S-R17, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Dick of the Hegemony (@dick_j0b).
The papers say Roland "Owl" Jessemusoff. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Pavel Jessemusoff's eyes. Nobody in S-R17 argues.

Roland "Owl" Jessemusoff watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere. The letter for Roland "Owl" Jessemusoff was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Roland "Owl" Jessemusoff liked the crossed-out parts best.
Roland "Owl" Jessemusoff has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz, gravely wounded.
Roland borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
ldscheffelmaier: Arno Ldscheffelma arrived on Day 13 as a replacement. The men in N-F1 had been fighting for 13 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Arno Ldscheffelma lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Arno Ldscheffelma got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Teodor Wrld snores. Arno Ldscheffelma does not. Arno now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Arno Ldscheffelma approved the method.
Arno wrote back to Rosa and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
lolmujahid_: Severin Lolmujahid arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Severin Lolmujahid fought Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel in a trench no wider than a door. Severin Lolmujahid came home with Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel's cap badge. (@thembamstel) The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F12, Severin Lolmujahid listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Severin Lolmujahid snores. Cyril Connorboi does not. Cyril now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Severin Lolmujahid looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Severin Lolmujahid tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Severin Lolmujahid. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Severin Lolmujahid crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at T-F12 holds again.
Severin Lolmujahid and Pavel Volna carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
At Verdel Ridge, Severin Lolmujahid of the Concord and Oskar Octi of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Severin Lolmujahid stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of T-F12, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Severin laid duckboards in T-F12. The first man to walk on them said it was like a street in a real town.
m4sk3dn3k0boi: The sergeant gave Hugo Boi a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Hugo Boi closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Grey Mill has been won. Hugo Boi listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A supply man offered Hugo Boi a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Hugo Boi tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Hugo Boi coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Dawn watch. Hugo Boi put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Ulrich Mercenary, grazed.
Hugo Boi fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Anselm Jdanieltzn, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
A bullet hit Hugo Boi's belt buckle at T-F22 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Wendel "Bones" Dyl of the Concord (@__dyl_g).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Hugo is whole again, or near enough for the line.
mekli_cz: Roland "Hollow" Mekli came from Belmonte, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

A letter reached Roland "Hollow" Mekli from Belmonte. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland "Hollow" Mekli watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Roland "Hollow" Mekli tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

A bullet hit Roland "Hollow" Mekli in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F20. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka). Roland "Hollow" Mekli was hit at Q-F20 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka).
Konrad "Doc" Mekli arrived carrying the family name of Roland "Hollow" Mekli. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Konrad "Doc" Mekli held the mirror while Albin Deer shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Konrad "Doc" Mekli approved the method.

Konrad "Doc" Mekli was found at the bottom of the trench at Q-F20, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah). Konrad "Doc" Mekli was killed at Q-F20 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah).
A letter came with Wendel Mekli: "I am Konrad "Doc" Mekli's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Wendel Mekli felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F20. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka).
The stitches came out of Wendel's leg this morning. The medic checked each one twice and said he could go back to Q-F20.
roundyboi_: Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi came from Old Harrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi taught Karel "Mud" Ajango to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. After what happened at Grey Mill, Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached V-F12 with the rations. Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi ate while listening to the revised orders.
The relief reached V-F12 without Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi turned up at a neighbouring battalion, having walked the wrong way for a day and a half. He came home to V-F12 with three new friends and no explanation.
Asked what he will do after the war, Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi said: 'Be a choir singer in Old Harrow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi used it. Quentin Edenfield was gravely wounded.

Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi was on watch at V-F12 when the night raid hit. The men found Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Casimir Singh of the Hegemony (@aishwarya.singh_05).
The House of Roundyboi sent another. Ivo Roundyboi, cousin of Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The men have learned that Ivo Roundyboi tells terrible jokes. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Ivo lay behind a dead tree trunk at V-F12 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Bastian Totaltbecksv was badly wounded. Ivo asked to leave the snipers and serve as a field cook. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
totally.am.toastyy: On the way to S-F9, Arno Toastyy tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Arno Toastyy is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Arno Toastyy read a theatre review while peeling supper.

Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Arno Toastyy watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A clear shot from S-F9. Arno Toastyy badly wounded Wendel Yurboixav and slid back down below the parapet. A bullet went through Arno Toastyy's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Arno Toastyy waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.

The medics would not give up on Arno Toastyy. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F9 today. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Arno Toastyy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Arno Toastyy fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Yann Vee, grazed.
Arno Toastyy had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Norbert Slc crossed it, Arno Toastyy fired. Norbert Slc was grazed.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Arno Toastyy closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.

Arno Toastyy felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F9. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).

Arno Toastyy's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F9 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Arno Toastyy helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Arno Toastyy laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Arno Toastyy could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Arno Toastyy counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Wendel Willskeltony was grazed.
Arno Toastyy followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.

A single shot from across the wire hit Arno Toastyy in the thigh at S-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Emil "Spark" Austin of the Concord (@joseph_austin15_). A single shot at S-F9. Arno Toastyy sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Emil "Spark" Austin of the Concord (@joseph_austin15_).
The papers say Edmund Toastyy. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Arno Toastyy's eyes. Nobody in S-F9 argues.
Edmund Toastyy watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-F9 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Wendel Yurboixav was badly wounded.
Edmund Toastyy agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Edmund Toastyy received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Edmund slipped on the duckboards at S-F9 just as a bullet went by. He lost some skin from the fall and none from the bullet. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo).
underthrone99: Quentin Underthrone reached S-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Quentin Underthrone (Concord) and Felix "Parson" Brendanm (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Hill 304. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Underthrone got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F2 with the rations. Quentin Underthrone ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet went through Quentin Underthrone's sleeve at S-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin Underthrone is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Quentin Underthrone tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Quentin Underthrone fired, and Edmund Ringwraith was gravely wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Quentin Underthrone aimed a step ahead and fired: Albin Prokes, grazed.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F2 in the middle of the night. Quentin Underthrone met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Eisenblatter of the Hegemony (@kaliel.eisenblatter).

Jonas "Parson" Underthrone came to the front because his uncle Quentin Underthrone never came home. He carries a tin of tobacco. The snipers took Jonas "Parson" Underthrone in on a busy morning in S-F2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Jonas "Parson" Underthrone had just lit a cigarette at S-F2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Arno "Tin" Ryukov of the Hegemony (@ryukov46). A clear shot from S-F2. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone grazed Anselm Boxknight and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Jonas "Parson" Underthrone before dusk. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone is number 309 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The medics cleaned Jonas "Parson" Underthrone's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F2.
The parcel for Jonas "Parson" Underthrone contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
A beetle crawled across Jonas "Parson" Underthrone's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
Jonas "Parson" Underthrone spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Jonas "Parson" Underthrone tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Jonas. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
